Title: 2026-01-16 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Doubloon Camps to be impossible to capture under certain conditions.

=== Battlegrounds: Volskaya Foundry ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Triglav Protector
    • [Undocumented] Damage bonus when both slots are occupied reduced from 45% to 35%.
    • [Undocumented] Cooldown reduction when both slots are occupied reduced from 40% to 35%.
  • Triglav Gunner
    • [Undocumented] Damage bonus when both slots are occupied reduced from 45% to 35%.
    • [Undocumented] Cooldown reduction when both slots are occupied reduced from 40% to 35%.
    • [Undocumented] Energy Regeneration when both slots are occupied reduced from 40% to 35%.

=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Beetles to still have a duration, in addition to losing their Health over time.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Globe of Annihilation [Q]
    • [Undocumented] Upon reaching 225 Annihilation, also removes the damage reduction against Monsters.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Health decay for Azmodan's Demon Warriors to not scale with levels.

=== Heroes: Deathwing ===
[Updates]
  Stats:
  • [Undocumented] Attack Damage increased from 110 to 117.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Molten Blood
      • [Undocumented] Additional functionality: Now grants Form Switch, which can be activated to swap Form.
  • Level 7
    • Firestorm
      • [Undocumented] Cooldown reduction for Deathwing's landing Abilities increased from 2 to 3 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Deathwing's Baseline Quest to reset when using Dragonflight.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Deathwing's Lava Burst to deal damage after an additional 0.25 seconds.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Gazlowe's Rock-It! Turrets to not lose their Health over time.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Frostbite [Trait]
    • [Undocumented] Additional functionality: Ice Cold now also gives Unstoppable and immunity to damage over time effects for the duration.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Jaina's Ice Cold to not show correctly.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Ravage [Q]
    • [Undocumented] Kerrigan now gains stacks when enemies die within 3 range.
    • [Undocumented] Time window for cooldown refund reduced from 1.5 to 0.75 seconds.
    • [Undocumented] Baseline Quest requirements increased from 85/150 to 100/250.
    • [Undocumented] After reaching 100 stacks, enemy Heroes killed grant 14 stacks.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Storm Bolt [Q]
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Perfect Storm
      • [Undocumented] Additional functionality: The cooldown cannot be reset more than once every 10 seconds.
  • Level 20
    • Mountain King
      • [Undocumented] New: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss have an extra charge.
    • Rewind
      • [Undocumented] Removed.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Muradin's Storm Bolt to deal 1 more damage for each stack.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the range splat for Muradin's Dwarf Toss to not be visible.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Muradin's Skullcraker to Stun before Muradin's post-damage effects happened.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Egg's Health Regeneration to not scale with levels.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Updates]
  Stats:
  • [Undocumented] Mana increased from 450 to 500.
  • [Undocumented] Mana Regeneration increased from 2.7 to 3 per second.
  Base:
  • Sentinel [W]
    • [Undocumented] Mana cost increased from 50 to 55.
  • Lunar Flare [E]
    • [Undocumented] Mana cost increased from 60 to 65.
  • Shadowstalk [R1]
    • [Undocumented] Mana cost increased from 75 to 85.
  • Starfall [R2]
    • [Undocumented] Mana cost increased from 75 to 85.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Tyrande's Sentinel to not be correctly affected by cooldown reduction effects.

=== Heroes: Yrel ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Divine Purpose [D]
    • [Undocumented] Cooldown reduced from 16 to 8 seconds.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 16
    • Mutalisk
      • [Undocumented] Mutalisk's Health decay reduced from 42 to 10 per second.
      • [Undocumented] Mutalisk duration effectively increased from 10 to 42 seconds.
